Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that starts an OAuth or OIDC authorization-code login using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import requests
from urllib.parse import urlencode

# Configuration for the OAuth provider
CLIENT_ID = 'your_client_id'
CLIENT_SECRET = 'your_client_secret'
REDIRECT_URI = 'https://yourapp.com/callback'
AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT = 'https://provider.com/oauth/authorize'
TOKEN_ENDPOINT = 'https://provider.com/oauth/token'
SCOPES = 'openid profile email'

# Start the OAuth authorization code flow
def start_oauth_flow():
    # Build the authorization URL
    params = {
        'client_id': CLIENT_ID,
        'response_type': 'code',
        'redirect_uri': REDIRECT_URI,
        'scope': ' '.join(SCOPES),
    }
    authorization_url = f'{AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT}?{urlencode(params)}'
    
    # Redirect the user to the authorization URL
    print(f'Please go to the following URL and authorize the application:\n{authorization_url}')
    # In a real application, you would redirect the user to this URL in a web browser

# Example usage
start_oauth_flow()
```
